title: RoomGauge: Material Plan

candidates.name: RoomGauge: Material Plan
candidates.why: The ownable carrier joins the measured room job to the material-plan output without claiming magic scanning.

candidates.name: Room Estimator
candidates.why: It is a bare category phrase and cannot own the integrated measurement-to-export workflow.

candidates.name: RoomGauge
candidates.why: The carrier is memorable but omits the material-plan outcome users need to search for.

candidates.name: MeasureMint
candidates.why: It suggests measurement but not materials, rooms, or a contractor-facing outcome.

candidates.name: Blueprint
candidates.why: The metaphor is broad and risks a title collision with generic plan applications.

rejected.name: Plumbline: Room Estimate
rejected.reason: The exact-carrier search surfaced existing Plumbline listings, including Plumbline and Plumbline by Solvyne, so the candidate has poor ownership headroom.

rejected.name: Room Planner Pro
rejected.reason: It copies the crowded planner category and promises a generic planner rather than an opening-aware material plan.

audience: A homeowner who needs a correctable room measurement and material quantities before buying renovation supplies or discussing a job with a contractor.
rationale: Measured candidate shelves contain high-install room-planning and measurement apps, while the proposed title names the distinct material-plan result rather than a generic planner or a competitor title.
collisionCheck: On 2026-10-08, scan-titles returned zero visible cards for RoomGauge and RoomGauge Material Plan in the signed-out Play search. This is not trademark clearance; no USPTO, EUIPO/TMview, WIPO, or Russian register was queried.
localisationCheck: RoomGauge: Material Plan is 24 characters and RoomGauge: план материалов is 27 characters, both within Play's 30-character cap; a native Russian review remains required.

scoringRubric.floor: chosen >= 70 with no dimension below 2.5; a hard check outranks the score
